samples.question: What should I keep in mind before drawing a weight trend from my saved Progress check-ins?
samples.reply:
Before drawing a weight trend from your saved Progress check-ins, remember that each measurement is an independent data point with its own date. Your profile weight (72 kg) and recent check-in (71 kg on 2026-10-30) are separate records; the former does not automatically establish the latter as your current state for trend analysis.

To create a valid trend, ensure you are comparing measurements taken under similar conditions over time. Since logged exercise loads are self-reported and food scans use estimated grams based on calorie percentages, focus on the explicit dates and values in your Progress history rather than inferred data.
